card.name: Inside long medical terms like antimalarials
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a longer medical word that is split into parts, most often 'antimal' followed by 'ar' in 'antimalarials'. It also appears in words like Lyme, extravasation and metastatic.

modes.label: Antimalarial word
modes.description: The 'ar' or 'arial' piece inside 'antimalarials' in drug interaction lists.

modes.label: Other split medical words
modes.description: The middle piece of other long clinical words such as extravasation or metastatic.

card.plain: It fires partway through long medical words that the model has to read in pieces, especially 'antimalarials'.
